metadataRaw.title: Easy Hip Pain Relief Exercises for Seniors
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy hip pain relief exercises designed for seniors (ages 55 and over). They're great also for helping with stiffness and tightness caused from arthritis.

These exercises are simple, straightforward movements that may give quick hip relief, even within 30 seconds. They can be done at home and require no equipment. 

Each exercise works differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most relief. 

Watch now and get rid of hip pain at home!

0:00 Intro
1:00 Stretching Exercise 1
